criteria.criterion: plugin/skills/plan/SKILL.md has frontmatter name: plan and a description; supporting files, if any, sit beside it in plugin/skills/plan/
criteria.evidence: SKILL.md frontmatter: name: plan, description present; only file in plugin/skills/plan/

criteria.criterion: It tells the session to write .vloop/state/state.json as state/v1 with base, shell, status planning, iteration 0, timestamps, run_id/brief/branch empty, and each task's fields
criteria.evidence: 'Task shape' section and top-level fields list: git rev-parse HEAD, vloop config get shell, run_id/brief/branch stay "", per-task field list

criteria.criterion: It assigns kind to every task, and area only when areas prints a value
References are the brief's binding references distributed with reasons; no discovery
criteria.evidence: 'Distributing references': 'Never cite a document the brief does not cite', B-5

criteria.criterion: Before finishing it requires schema validate, task validate and gates run on the base three ways
criteria.evidence: 'Check every gate on the base — three ways' and 'Before you finish' items 1, 2, 7

criteria.criterion: Gate contradicting its own acceptance is left to gate_dispute; gates follow plan's shell and host tools
criteria.evidence: gate_dispute paragraph after the three checks; verify bullet on plan's shell / BSD tools

criteria.criterion: Prose written in the configured language; keys/enums/ids/commands English; skill itself English
Every rule of loop-plan survives adapted to vloop, or omission explained; nothing tells session to commit, set status, move ref, or run denied command
criteria.evidence: Parse-vs-text, source-text, restored-file, baseline-decay, VLOOP_ACTIVE_TASK/GATE_TASK, naming, durable files, regression net all present; omissions (amend.sh, knowledge survey) explained in proposal notes; 'You do not commit, set a status, move a ref'

criteria.criterion: The skill carries at least one fenced json example with schema state/v1 that validates and shows a fresh plan
criteria.evidence: json block in Task shape; driver gate (GATE OK) validated it and asserted fresh-plan shape

criteria.criterion: fence/settings.json gains allow rules for config get, task validate, task gate; no deny removed
criteria.evidence: git diff fence/settings.json: three additions only

criteria.criterion: TestPluginSkills passes on the real plugin
criteria.evidence: gates/T2.log ends GATE OK, which includes pass_on for the real plugin
